Description: Temp power pole 100amps (See B2016-05277)

We would like to revise the plan for a new service. The existing permitted planset shows a new 400A two-gang meter main that feeds a new 200A subpanel for the unit we want to interconnect solar to. As you know, 400A main panels are particularly large and with the subpanel and solar inverter this would take up a lot of wall space. Instead, landing a new service into two side-by-side 200A main panels with distribution accomplishes the same thing electrically and takes up less wall space. A gutter above the two main panels allows the single overhead service to be split to the two main panels.
_cells: We would like to revise the plan for a new service. As you know, 400A main panels are particularly large and with the subpanel and solar inverter this would take up a lot of wall space. Instead, landing a new service into two side-by-side 200A main panels with distribution accomplishes the same thing electrically and takes up less wall space. A gutter above the two main panels allows the single overhead service to be split to the two main panels.
